sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Three separate, unrelated encounters completable in any order — do the longest one (Statue of Ice) first so it isn't rushed at the end. All three need to finish before the path to Dhuum opens.

sections.heading: Statue of Ice — Broken King
bullets: Capture green ice orbs (one spawns per 2% of the boss's health lost) while damaging him — an uncaught orb detonates for massive squad damage.

Capturing an orb grants a stack of Frozen Wind (expires after 45s) — at 3 stacks, capturing another orb triggers Glaciate: frozen for 10 seconds with continuous damage. Healing can save a Glaciated player, and it resets their stacks.
Spread orb-catching across multiple players rather than one hero-carrying it — if squad DPS is too high, orbs can spawn faster than one person can grab them, and an uncaught orb is a wipe risk.
Ice cracks from his staff slams send out damaging pulses — watch your footing.
Hard 3:30 enrage. Aim for ~75k squad DPS; below ~60k risks the enrage outright.

sections.heading: Statue of Death & Resurrection — Eater of Souls
bullets: Collect red orbs to light 6 torches — 20 orbs total needed, collected across repeating phases (the boss regenerates to full after each phase until all torches are lit).
Watch for poison vomit AoEs and Twisted Spirit adds that need precise targeting.
Lost Spirit green circles launch you into the air (first at 40s, then every 50s after) — you get a 30-second window airborne to grab 5 orbs before landing.
Skeleton adds can overrun the group if ignored for too long.

sections.heading: Statue of Darkness — Eyes
bullets: Two throwers launch light orbs from an elevated platform while two squads stun and damage the Eyes below.
Both Eyes need to die within 8 seconds of each other, or the survivor regenerates and teleports away — sync your kills.
An Eye that isn't stunned by 70% health summons a Minotaur — keep a dedicated stunner (often a Druid with extended stun duration) re-stunning roughly every 10 seconds.
Eyes teleport at fixed health thresholds (85/70/55/40/25/10%) if left unstunned, and Light Thief adds need managing on top of everything else.
